policy.mode: Brief B: one to three products, incorporating Brief A

sources.authority: Base conversation, identity, collection, calendar, amount, exception and closing policy.
Later amendments for all accounts in this compilation, including accounts with only one product.
Exact request fields, enums, response fields, action success and service-failure semantics. The service does not enforce collection policy.

sources.reference: Supplied platform reference and compact-output instructions
sources.authority: Workflow execution and serialization, not bank policy.

priority: Use the OpenAPI contract for API representation and actual action results.
Brief B explicitly replaces conflicting Brief A rules.
Protect account information until the named customer passes both security questions.
Hardship takes precedence over ordinary persuasion and restructuring.
An actual successful transfer takes closing precedence over recorded promises.
Preserve recorded promises; distinguish them from unrecorded agreements.
Otherwise apply the applicable Brief A rule and its explicit exceptions.
Examples illustrate syntax and provide no additional bank rules.
overrides: Load and state every returned product before the initial payment question.
Ask about paying all products today once; subsequent individual negotiation starts at persuasion attempt 1.
Compute bands, deadlines, floors and persuasion budgets separately for each product.
For one customer-specified date covering all products, cap an affected product at its own deadline and disclose that date in the combined read-back.
Read all proposed promises together and obtain one confirmation before individual writes.
Paid and disputed products do not end the other products' negotiation.
Every unpromised product requires its own final note, including when no promise succeeds.
Any transfer prohibits all product notes. Discard unrecorded agreements on transfer; retain actual recorded promises.
A failed promise write is retried once. After its second failure, retain other successful promises and note that product service_error.

opening.first_sentence: I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded.
opening.address: Use the supplied title and last name.
opening.privacy: Before both security questions pass, do not mention collections, debt, payment, a product or account details.
opening.name_confirmation: Only yes, that's me, speaking, or the customer's own name confirms identity at this stage.
opening.name_budget: Ask at most twice. Answer an AI or scam question first; the following name question consumes the second ask. Two unclear responses produce not_reached/unclear.
opening.caller_first: If entry speech did not run, deliver the required opening and name question before proceeding. Do not count an undelivered question.

third_party.permitted: Opening identification and recording notice, followed by asking when the named customer can be reached. Do not disclose the reason for calling.
third_party.relative: A relative cannot answer security questions or receive account information, including when offering to pay.
third_party.deceased: Say I am sorry for your loss. Ask nothing else; close not_reached/deceased.
third_party.callback: A callback must be today or the next business day, at 10:00 through 19:00 inclusive, and strictly later than call now. Today may be a nonbusiness day; the alternative day must be the next business day.
third_party.callback_budget: After one invalid proposal ask once for another time. A second invalid proposal closes not_reached/no_callback. Incomplete date/time information is clarified before validating a complete proposal.
third_party.callback_result: Close not_reached/callback only after schedule_callback reports ok=true.

questions: What is your date of birth?
What are the last four digits of the phone number on file?
security.representation: DOB is YYYY-MM-DD. Purely numeric dates are day/month/year. Four phone digits remain a string, preserving leading zeroes.
security.assembly: Assemble incomplete answers across turns. Apply corrections before validation. Never submit partial answers or supply the customer's answer.
security.budget: Three wrong answers total across both questions. Retry only the failed question.
security.hint: day_month_swapped requires asking for the month as a word and does not consume a wrong-answer attempt.
security.unreadable: An ok=false unreadable answer is not a wrong answer.
security.decline: Explain once that the questions protect the account. A second refusal, including a second question about the purpose instead of answering, closes not_verified/declined.
security.failure: After three wrong answers, direct the customer to the mobile app or a branch and close not_verified/failed.
security.prerequisite: Only actual successful verification of both fields, including the final all_verified result, permits get_account. Account discussion and writes also require a valid loaded account.

calendar.anchor: The call's now, using its supplied local date and time; never the server clock.
calendar.business_days: Monday through Friday excluding the listed holidays.
calendar.deadline_algorithm: Start with the day after today. Advance one calendar day at a time, counting only business days, until the band's count is reached.
calendar.valid_promise: Business day, on or after today, and on or before that product's deadline.
calendar.nonbusiness_proposal: For a named date not after the deadline, offer the next business day and obtain agreement. Do not silently move the customer's date.
calendar.late_proposal: For a single-product date after its deadline, state and offer its deadline. Rejection is a flat refusal. Brief B's common-date exception instead caps affected products and discloses this in read-back.
calendar.vague_period: Ask once for an exact day. If the customer still gives no exact day, propose the deadline. Keep this allowance across paraphrases.
calendar.weekday_convention: This weekday is in the current Monday–Sunday calendar week. Next weekday is in the following calendar week.
calendar.incomplete_dates: Resolve a day/month fragment only when previous customer context fixes the missing parts. Otherwise ask for the missing information; do not substitute a deadline for a parse failure.
calendar.attempt_one: The last business day of the current week; if today is that day, the last business day of the following week.
calendar.weekend_attempt_gap: The source does not specify a replacement if the literal attempt-one calculation is already in the past on a weekend. In that exceptional state, ask for an exact permissible business day without inventing a fixed offer date or consuming an undelivered persuasion attempt.

amounts.full_first: Propose the full past-due amount. Never ask how much the customer can pay.
amounts.too_much: Offer the floor once and explain that the rest remains overdue.
amounts.below_floor: Explain that the proposed amount cannot be recorded; offer the floor once.
amounts.floor_rejection: Treat rejection as a flat refusal. Do not repeat that floor offer; late-band attempt 2 may explicitly offer the floor on the deadline.
amounts.above_full: Do not silently reduce it or record more than past_due. Offer the full past-due amount and obtain agreement.
amounts.rounding: No rounding rule or currency is supplied. Preserve the customer's confirmed numeric amount, make no currency assumption and apply no monetary rounding.
amounts.notation: Speak numeric amounts without inventing a currency symbol or currency name.

negotiation.debt_statement: After verification and lookup, identify the collections team and late payment. State every product, past_due and days_late, one sentence per product, before a question. Credit-card labels include the ending digits.
negotiation.initial_question: Can you pay all of them today?
negotiation.initial_no: Start individual products at attempt 1; never ask about today again for each product.
negotiation.attempt_one: Full past_due, or the floor if the customer has already said full payment is too much, on the calculated attempt-one day.
negotiation.attempt_two: Late band only: the floor on the product's deadline.
negotiation.counting: Flat refusals and non-answers consume the opportunity for the next persuasion attempt. Dates and amounts proposed by the customer are not refusals. Malformed or ambiguous proposals require clarification and do not consume refusal attempts.
negotiation.exhaustion: Stop when the product's attempts are exhausted, and do not repeat rejected offers.
negotiation.hardship: Illness, a death in the family or job loss: one brief sympathetic sentence, no persuasion, offer support. Accepted support requires transfer queue support. Declined support resolves unpromised affected products as hardship. Preserve and validate voluntarily supplied payment terms.
negotiation.forbidden: No discount, waiver, instalment plan or invented term.

confirmation.readback: Read every proposed product, amount and date together; ask Do you confirm?
confirmation.correction: Resolve the changed product against the actual read-back, retain unaffected terms, revalidate and read all pending promises back again.
confirmation.write: Only a clear yes authorizes create_promise. Call once per confirmed product, with at most one retry after failure.
confirmation.recorded: Only ok=true records a promise. Never infer success from HTTP status or an envelope.
confirmation.immutable: One promise per product. A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled during this call; direct changes to the mobile app.
confirmation.required_message: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.

exceptions.paid: A payment of the current past-due amount: explain that payments can take one business day to appear; take no promise for that product and continue others.
exceptions.dispute: Debt not theirs, never held the product, or a product allegedly closed or paid off in the past: do not argue or take a promise for it; continue other products.
exceptions.restructuring: A new payment plan or lower-instalment request requires queue restructuring. Describe no plan. Hardship takes precedence.
exceptions.human: Before or after verification, ask once whether the assistant can help first. If the customer insists, use queue general and transfer reason human.
exceptions.ai: Say you are Freya Bank's digital assistant and continue the applicable stage.
exceptions.scam: Say the customer can verify the call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number. Do not invent a number.
exceptions.unknown_information: Say you do not have that information.
exceptions.not_talk: On the second statement that the customer does not want to talk, use not_verified/declined before verification; after verification resolve remaining unpromised products as refused.

notes.brief_a_only: Brief A alone would never use add_note; Brief B overrides this for this compilation.
notes.when: Defer notes until all negotiation and promise writes are resolved and finalization has begun. Do not write provisional notes.
notes.scope: Exactly one successful note for each product without an actual recorded promise.
notes.service_error: A product whose create_promise failed twice.
notes.transfer: No notes on any transfer, before or after it.
notes.text: Optional. Omit it unless a concise factual explanation is needed; do not include security answers.

closing.order: Finish required confirmations, thank the customer and say goodbye, then close_call. It is the last bank operation. Hang up silently only after its actual ok=true result.
closing.one_path: Reconcile closing against actual successful transfers, recorded promises and final notes. Preserve unverified and not-reached classifications.

combinations.condition: At least one recorded promise and no successful transfer.
No recorded promise and all products successfully noted paid.
No recorded promise; first non-paid product note is refused.
No recorded promise; first non-paid product note is hardship.
No recorded promise; first non-paid product note is dispute.
No recorded promise; first non-paid product note is service_error.
Repeated security refusal or repeated refusal to talk before verification.
Second invalid callback proposal or no callback available.
Number does not belong to the customer.
Name still unconfirmed after two asks.

execution.other_failures: No additional bank-specific retry budget or closing outcome is supplied for lookup, callback, transfer, note or closing failure. Do not invent one. Preserve the unresolved operation, report failure honestly and allow a requested repeat only for the documented HTTP 500 condition that guarantees nothing was recorded.
execution.close_failure: Do not hang up, claim closure or run another bank operation after a failed close. A repeat of the same close is allowed only for the contract's documented HTTP 500 failure.
execution.missing_fixtures: No usable test customer identity or example conversation is supplied. Omit smoke and scenarios.
execution.checks_scope: The included checks are local deterministic replay cases, not evidence that live speech extraction or end-to-end dialogue has passed.

workflow.system_prompt: You are Freya Bank's digital assistant. Speak English, use the customer's supplied title and last name, and keep questions short. Never disclose collections, payment, debt, product or account information before both security checks pass. Never invent a currency, customer-service number, account fact or payment arrangement. Follow the current task exactly. A computed utterance is authoritative; do not add questions or negotiation. Tool results are authoritative only when the bank body reports ok=true. After a tool result, speak or immediately perform the next authorized action. Never narrate tools, nodes, routing, IDs or internal state. Never call a tool merely to inspect an unvalidated proposal. Never claim an operation succeeded when it did not. The final farewell must precede close_call, and only the terminal node hangs up.

opening.name: opening

on_enter.text: I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?

opening.task_message: If the opening has not been spoken in history, say exactly: I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded. Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}? No tool is permitted. Only yes, that's me, speaking or the customer's own name confirms the person. Hello, go ahead and who is this do not. Do not ask security questions or disclose the purpose here. Fresh replies are evaluated before the next authorized utterance.

extraction_schema.name: id_event
extraction_schema.description: Classify only the newest caller reply. self only for yes, that's me, speaking, or their own name matching the person asked for. A relative offering to pay is third_party. Hello and go ahead are unclear. A robot question is ai. Do not infer security success.

identity.name: identity
identity.task_message: The complete authorized utterance is {{identity_speech}}. Do not add a question, disclose account information or call a tool. The only security fields are date of birth, followed by the last four digits of the phone number on file. Never ask another security question or supply an answer. A relative cannot answer either question. Wait for the customer's reply. The evaluator retains split digits, corrections and failed-question state.

extraction_schema.name: id_event
extraction_schema.description: Only the newest reply. Use answer for a security answer or fragment. Asking what the call is about instead of giving security is purpose. A relative offering to pay is third_party. Use callback when any callback date/time is supplied. yes/no apply to the last explicit yes/no question. self is the narrow name confirmation. retry requires a request to repeat a failed service action.

extraction_schema.name: id_answer
extraction_schema.description: Customer-supplied security words or digits from this reply only. Preserve leading zeroes. Keep the corrected intended portion, not a value the customer retracts. Do not invent missing day, month, year or digits. Empty when absent.

extraction_schema.name: id_answer_mode
extraction_schema.description: append for a continuation of an incomplete security answer; replace for a complete answer or a correction replacing the previous answer. neutral if no answer. Never label a correction as a wrong answer.

extraction_schema.name: callback_day_words
extraction_schema.description: Quote the caller's callback day expression without resolving it using the real clock, for example tomorrow or 27 October 2026. This is raw wording, not a normalized date. Empty if absent.

extraction_schema.name: callback_time_words
extraction_schema.description: Callback time. Normalize an unambiguous spoken time to HH:MM in 24-hour form; preserve an ambiguous expression instead of guessing AM/PM. Empty if absent.

transitions.description: Evaluate the fresh identity or callback reply exactly once.
Evaluate the actual security result; a negative result never advances security.
Validate and calculate the loaded account before any account conversation.

evaluate.name: evaluate

transitions.description: A complete customer-supplied security answer is ready for validation.
Both security questions have actually passed.
Verified, loaded account and initialized authorized question.
One validated action or an honest unresolved service-failure statement.
The final outcome is reconciled and the farewell is initialized.
Safe initialized identity speech, including calculation failure.

collection.name: collection
collection.task_message: The complete authorized utterance is {{collection_speech}}. Ask no additional question and call no tool. Wait for a fresh reply. Preserve the entire conversation. The evaluator handles product order, per-product attempts, floors, calendars, support, disputes, paid claims and combined confirmation. Never ask how much the customer can pay. A proposed date or amount is not a refusal. A correction refers to the products actually read back.

extraction_schema.name: pay_event
extraction_schema.description: Newest reply only. yes is an unqualified acceptance of the latest question; a correction is terms, not yes. no is a clear refusal without customer payment terms. terms includes partial, malformed or ambiguous proposals and product-specific statements captured in slots. Illness, bereavement or job loss is hardship and takes precedence over restructuring or ordinary refusal; still capture volunteered terms in slots. A past payment or old closed product belongs in a slot. An unrelated date in small talk is not payment terms. Empty or unclear non-answer is unknown.

extraction_schema.name: p1_kind
extraction_schema.description: First correlated product statement in the newest reply. paid means the current past-due amount was paid; historically paid off or closed is dispute. too_much means full payment is unaffordable. proposal includes a new or corrected amount/date or an answer supplying one missing detail. neutral if absent. Never convert an unparseable proposal into refusal.

extraction_schema.name: p1_target
extraction_schema.description: First statement's product reference as spoken, such as card, personal loan, car loan, both loans, all, or ending digits. Do not invent internal IDs. Empty if unstated. Preserve shorter natural aliases.

extraction_schema.name: p1_amount_words
extraction_schema.description: First statement's corrected customer-proposed amount. Unambiguous spoken numbers may be normalized to plain decimal. Preserve each or total when relevant. Empty if not supplied. Never supply the agent's offer as a new customer proposal.

extraction_schema.name: p1_day_words
extraction_schema.description: Quote the first statement's corrected payment-day wording. Preserve this/next, vague periods, weekday and numeric fragments. Do not resolve against the real clock or invent a year. This is raw wording for deterministic interpretation, not a normalized date. Empty if absent.

extraction_schema.name: p2_kind
extraction_schema.description: Second distinct correlated product statement in this reply, with the same meanings as the first slot. Do not duplicate or retain a retracted first value. neutral if absent.

extraction_schema.name: p2_target
extraction_schema.description: Second statement's spoken product reference or all. Never invent an internal ID. Empty if absent.

extraction_schema.name: p2_amount_words
extraction_schema.description: Second statement's corrected proposed amount, preserving each or total. Plain decimal normalization is allowed. Empty if absent.

extraction_schema.name: p2_day_words
extraction_schema.description: Second statement's raw corrected payment-day wording, preserving relative and incomplete expressions without using the real clock. Empty if absent.

extraction_schema.name: p3_kind
extraction_schema.description: Third distinct correlated product statement, with the first slot's meanings. neutral if absent. There are at most three loaded products.

extraction_schema.name: p3_target
extraction_schema.description: Third statement's spoken product reference or all, without invented IDs. Empty if absent.

extraction_schema.name: p3_amount_words
extraction_schema.description: Third statement's corrected proposed amount, preserving each or total. Plain decimal normalization is allowed. Empty if absent.

extraction_schema.name: p3_day_words
extraction_schema.description: Third statement's raw corrected payment-day wording; retain relative periods and fragments without resolving against the real clock. Empty if absent.

transitions.description: Evaluate fresh payment statements and corrections before speaking or writing.

actions.name: actions

on_enter.prompt:
{{action_instruction}}
This is the entire permitted action. Do not improvise a payment offer or ask another question. If a fresh caller interruption supplies a correction or requests a human, restructuring or support before the bank operation has begun, do not perform the pending write; allow the extracted interruption to be evaluated. Once final notes have begun, finish only the already-decided finalization.

actions.task_message:
{{action_instruction}}
Only the single named action is authorized. Values come from the validated instruction, not guessed intent. A promise requires successful identity checks, a loaded account, valid terms and the combined clear confirmation. Do not record merely agreed terms on a transfer. Never add notes on a transfer. Each result must lead to an immediate authorized action or speech. If the result has already arrived, do not repeat the previous action. During an unresolved service failure, say the supplied failure statement and wait; do not retry without the specified authorization.

extraction_schema.name: action_event
extraction_schema.description: Newest caller interruption only. correction changes pending promise terms; human requests a person; hardship is illness, bereavement or job loss and takes precedence over restructuring. retry explicitly asks to repeat a failed operation. neutral for no new interruption. Never infer success from the customer.

extraction_schema.name: action_target
extraction_schema.description: Product reference actually spoken in a correction, without invented internal IDs. Empty if unstated.

extraction_schema.name: action_amount_words
extraction_schema.description: Corrected customer amount only, optionally normalized to plain decimal; preserve each or total. Empty if absent.

extraction_schema.name: action_day_words
extraction_schema.description: Raw corrected payment-day wording. Do not invent missing details or resolve relative wording using the real clock. Empty if absent.

transitions.description: Process the authoritative bank result or a fresh interruption, preserving both if they arrive together.

finish.name: finish

on_enter.prompt:
Say exactly: {{farewell_speech}}
Immediately afterward CALL close_call with outcome {{close_outcome}} and reason {{close_reason}}. Omit reason for promise or paid. Do not wait for another caller reply. Do not call any other tool. Do not add a question.

finish.task_message: If the farewell has not yet been delivered for this finalization, say exactly {{farewell_speech}}, then immediately CALL close_call. The authorized outcome is {{close_outcome}} and reason is {{close_reason}}; omit reason for promise and paid. close_call is the final bank operation. Its hook reconciles actual state. After ok=true the terminal hangs up silently. If close_call fails, do not claim closure or hang up. Say that the call record could not be completed. Only an explicit customer request to retry a documented HTTP 500 failure permits repeating that same close; no other bank tool is permitted. Do not repeat a successful close.

transitions.description: The final bank closing operation actually succeeded.

verify_identity.description: Engine-run validation of one complete, customer-supplied security answer. DOB first, then phone_last4. Never validate a partial answer, a relative's answer, an invented answer or an already passed field.

field_descriptions.field: date_of_birth first; phone_last4 only after date_of_birth actually passes.
field_descriptions.answer: The assembled corrected customer answer: YYYY-MM-DD for DOB, or exactly four digits including leading zeroes.

verify_identity.pre_process_code:
import json
try:
    vars['engine_event'] = 'idle'
    vars['bank_event_data'] = dict()
    f = vars.get('flow', dict())
    if isinstance(f, str):
        f = json.loads(f)
    request = f.get('security_request', dict())
    body = dict(customer_id=str(vars.get('customer_id', '')))
    if not f.get('third') and request.get('field') in ['date_of_birth', 'phone_last4'] and (request.get('field') == 'date_of_birth' and not f.get('dob_ok') or request.get('field') == 'phone_last4' and f.get('dob_ok') and not f.get('phone_ok')):
        body.update(request)
    config['body'] = body
    config['connect_retries'] = 0
except Exception:
    config['body'] = dict()
    vars['engine_event'] = 'idle'
verify_identity.post_process_code:
try:
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        result.pop('header', None)
        result.pop('headers', None)
        data = result.get('data')
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            data = dict(error='Unreadable service response')
            result['data'] = data
        vars['bank_event_data'] = dict(data)
        vars['bank_status'] = result.get('status_code', '')
        vars['engine_event'] = 'verify'
        data['engine_event'] = 'verify'
        data['what_to_do_next'] = 'Immediately continue with the authorized security-result instruction. A failed answer does not pass verification; a swapped-date hint requires the month as a word. Do not discuss the account.'
except Exception:
    vars['engine_event'] = 'verify'
    vars['bank_event_data'] = dict(error='Unreadable service response')

get_account.description: Load all late products only after both security questions actually pass. No customer account facts are known before this response.

except Exception:

    if isinstance(result, dict):

        result.pop('headers', None)
        data = result.get('data')
        if not isinstance(data, dict):

except Exception:

    vars['bank_event_data'] = dict(error='Unreadable account response')

create_promise.description: CALL only when the current authorized instruction explicitly names create_promise, after the combined read-back received a clear yes. Use only the confirmed product, amount and date. At most two actual attempts for one product; never repeat a successful promise.

field_descriptions.product_id: Copy the actual product_id in the current authorized action.
field_descriptions.amount: The customer's confirmed, validated amount. Never silently substitute a floor or full amount.
field_descriptions.date: The customer's confirmed, validated YYYY-MM-DD date, including any disclosed Brief B common-date adjustment.

create_promise.pre_process_code:
import json
import datetime
try:
    vars['engine_event'] = 'idle'
    vars['bank_event_data'] = dict()
    f = vars.get('flow', dict())
    if isinstance(f, str):
        f = json.loads(f)
    action = f.get('action', dict())
    payload = action.get('payload', dict())
    body = dict(customer_id=str(vars.get('customer_id', '')))
    p = next((p for p in f.get('products', []) if p.get('product_id') == payload.get('product_id')), dict())
    holidays = ['2026-10-26', '2026-11-11', '2026-11-26', '2026-12-25', '2027-01-01']
    day = datetime.date.fromisoformat(str(payload.get('date', '')))
    today = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('now', '')).replace('Z', '+00:00')).date()
    valid = action.get('name') == 'create_promise' and f.get('verified') and f.get('loaded') and f.get('confirmed') and not f.get('transfer_reason') and p.get('status') == 'agreed' and p.get('write_attempts', 0) < 2
    valid = valid and p.get('amount') == payload.get('amount') and p.get('date') == payload.get('date') and p['floor'] <= float(payload['amount']) <= p['full'] and today <= day <= datetime.date.fromisoformat(p['deadline']) and day.weekday() < 5 and day.isoformat() not in holidays
    if valid:
        body.update(payload)
    vars['submitted_action'] = action
    vars['request_guard'] = 'ready' if valid else 'rejected'
    config['body'] = body
    config['connect_retries'] = 0
except Exception:
    config['body'] = dict()
    vars['request_guard'] = 'rejected'
create_promise.post_process_code:
try:
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        result.pop('header', None)
        result.pop('headers', None)
        data = result.get('data')
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            data = dict(error='Unreadable promise response')
            result['data'] = data
        vars['bank_event_data'] = dict(data)
        vars['bank_status'] = result.get('status_code', '')
        vars['engine_event'] = 'promise'
        data['engine_event'] = 'promise'
        data['what_to_do_next'] = 'The promise was recorded. Immediately deliver the authorized confirmation, including You will receive a text message confirming this promise., and continue the next authorized action.' if str(data.get('ok', False)).lower() == 'true' else 'This attempt did not record a promise. Immediately follow the authorized retry or failure instruction. Never say it was recorded.'
except Exception:
    vars['engine_event'] = 'promise'
    vars['bank_event_data'] = dict(error='Unreadable promise response')

add_note.description: CALL only during finalization when the authorized action names add_note. One note for the named product without a recorded promise. Never add a note before negotiation and promise writes finish, or on any transfer.

field_descriptions.product_id: The actual unpromised product_id from the authorized final action.
field_descriptions.reason: The final product reason: refused, hardship, dispute, paid or service_error.
field_descriptions.text: Optional factual note only. Omit unless needed. Never include security answers.

add_note.pre_process_code:
import json
try:
    vars['engine_event'] = 'idle'
    vars['bank_event_data'] = dict()
    f = vars.get('flow', dict())
    if isinstance(f, str):
        f = json.loads(f)
    action = f.get('action', dict())
    payload = action.get('payload', dict())
    p = next((p for p in f.get('products', []) if p.get('product_id') == payload.get('product_id')), dict())
    body = dict(customer_id=str(vars.get('customer_id', '')))
    valid = action.get('name') == 'add_note' and f.get('verified') and f.get('loaded') and f.get('finalizing') and not f.get('transfer_reason') and payload.get('product_id') not in f.get('notes', dict()) and p.get('status') == payload.get('reason') and payload.get('reason') in ['refused', 'hardship', 'dispute', 'paid', 'service_error']
    if valid:
        body.update(payload)
    config['body'] = body
    config['connect_retries'] = 0
    vars['submitted_action'] = action

close_call.pre_process_code:
import json
try:
    vars['closed_state'] = 'pending'
    f = vars.get('flow', dict())
    if isinstance(f, str):
        f = json.loads(f)
    candidate = f.get('close_candidate', dict())
    outcome = candidate.get('outcome', '')
    reason = candidate.get('reason', '')
    products = f.get('products', [])
    if f.get('transfer_reason'):
        outcome, reason = 'transferred', f['transfer_reason']
    elif outcome not in ['not_verified', 'not_reached'] and f.get('verified') and f.get('loaded'):
        complete = all(p.get('status') == 'recorded' or f.get('notes', dict()).get(p['product_id']) == p.get('status') for p in products)
        if not products or not complete:
            outcome, reason = '', ''
        elif any(p.get('status') == 'recorded' for p in products):
            outcome, reason = 'promise', ''
        elif all(p.get('status') == 'paid' for p in products):
            outcome, reason = 'paid', ''
        else:
            outcome = 'no_promise'
            reason = next(p['status'] for p in products if p['status'] != 'paid')
    allowed = dict(transferred=['restructuring', 'human', 'support'], no_promise=['refused', 'hardship', 'dispute', 'service_error'], not_verified=['failed', 'declined'], not_reached=['callback', 'no_callback', 'wrong_number', 'deceased', 'unclear'])
    valid = outcome in ['promise', 'paid'] or outcome in allowed and reason in allowed[outcome]
    body = dict(customer_id=str(vars.get('customer_id', '')))
    if valid:
        body['outcome'] = outcome
        if outcome not in ['promise', 'paid']:
            body['reason'] = reason
    config['body'] = body
    config['connect_retries'] = 0
    vars['close_outcome'] = outcome
    vars['close_reason'] = reason
except Exception:
    config['body'] = dict()
    vars['closed_state'] = 'pending'
